definitions.explanation: To work dough or similar material until it reaches the desired consistency.

definitions.gloss: to polish up; to refine; to perfect
definitions.explanation: To carefully develop and improve something through repeated effort.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ (to knead, to work over) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to carry through to completion). The ～⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ half is what adds the sense that the work has been taken all the way to a finished state, not merely begun.

USAGE:
- ⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to refine a strategy)
- ⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to polish a script)
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to develop an idea)
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}り{上|あ}げる (to knead dough thoroughly)

THE TWO SENSES:
Sense 1 is the literal one — physically working dough, clay, or bean paste until its texture is right. Sense 2 is the same action applied to a plan, a text, or a strategy, and is the more common use in everyday writing. Both share the image of prolonged, repeated working; the object tells you which sense is meant.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ alone describes the working itself with no implication that it is finished — ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ is working on a plan, while {練|ね}り{上|あ}げる says it came out fully formed.
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ is the general verb for finishing something off; it says nothing about the repeated kneading-over that {練|ね}り{上|あ}げる implies.
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ polishes a surface or a skill, not a plan or a dough.
